decisions.reason: The complete, substantive moment language restates the candidate's existing completeness and standalone-understandability requirements without changing them.
The instruction to use B-roll naturally is already represented by the existing contextual integration rule and adds no new constraint.
The clean-editing clause reiterates the existing clean and simple visual-editing standard without modifying its state.
Message 191 does not change the permitted source collection, topic constraint, or source exclusion rule.
White text only is already the candidate's current caption-color standard, and the source adds no new caption-effects rule.
The source does not mention or alter the required caption font.
The source contains no instruction changing hook selection or clip-opening quality.
Requiring a moment that teaches something real restates the existing substantive lesson, story, or real-point selection standard.
The twelve-clip launch batch was already active before message 191; the repeated count does not change current state, and the Thursday deadline is project-management timing.
References to approved clips going live are consistent with the existing approval-gated publishing rule and do not alter its authority or gate.
The stated 70-to-85-second duration exactly matches the candidate's current duration range.
The source concerns the separate twelve-clip launch batch and does not resume or modify the deferred monthly target of 140 approved clips.
